synopsis: EMESRT's 2024 Activity Report reports 17 published surface vehicle-interaction scenario storyboards, identified as published in 2019 [f320, f3750, f4079]. The booklet records an unresolved difference between that count and a 2019 trade article's count of 24 scenarios [f4079, f15607]. Across chapters on virtual job sites, machine motion and simulation trust, the report confirms that PR-5A was reviewed and updated in September 2024 [f4323, f6566, f7742]. However, the report does not specify a revision number for that update [f4324, f6566].
